name: Reimbursement of Fees of ST Students Studying in Sainik School Private Institutions
benefit: Free arrangement for accommodation, school fees and studies for the students.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized Sainik School or private institution covered under the scheme.
